tool_signatures.name: create_job
tool_signatures.description: Create a scheduled HTTP job. The kind is inferred — never set it yourself.

url.description: Destination URL to call. Must be reachable from the public internet (no localhost or private IPs).

method.description: HTTP method — GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

headers.description: HTTP headers to send, as a name->value object. Set a secret auth header so only smplkit can call your endpoint.

body.description: Request body sent verbatim on each run. Pair with a matching Content-Type header.

schedule.description: A 5-field cron expression for a RECURRING job (e.g. '0 7 * * *' for 7am daily). Omit for a manual or one-time job.

run_at.description: An ISO-8601 datetime to run the job ONCE (or 'now' to run once immediately). Mutually exclusive with `schedule`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the cron `schedule` runs in (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Recurring jobs only; defaults to UTC.

retry_policy.description: The id of an existing named retry policy to apply to failed runs. Retry policies are managed in the smplkit console — create one there, then pass its id.

environment.description: Which environment to enable/run the job in (default 'production').

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: HTTP headers to send, as a name->value object. Set a secret auth header so only smplkit can call your endpoint.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: HTTP method — GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Human-readable name for the job.

parameters.name: retry_policy
parameters.description: The id of an existing named retry policy to apply to failed runs. Retry policies are managed in the smplkit console — create one there, then pass its id.

parameters.description: An ISO-8601 datetime to run the job ONCE (or 'now' to run once immediately). Mutually exclusive with `schedule`.

parameters.description: A 5-field cron expression for a RECURRING job (e.g. '0 7 * * *' for 7am daily). Omit for a manual or one-time job.

parameters.name: timeout

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone the cron `schedule` runs in (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Recurring jobs only; defaults to UTC.

tool_signatures.name: set_flag
tool_signatures.description: Set a flag's value, kill switch, and targeting in one environment.

environment.description: Environment to change (default 'production'). Use list_environments to see valid targets.

value.description: The value served in this environment when no rule matches (the per-environment default). Omit to leave it unchanged; pass null to clear it so the environment falls back to the flag's global default.

enabled.description: The kill switch. False skips all rules and serves the flag's global default; True re-enables targeting.

rules.description: **This replaces the environment's entire rule set.** To add a rule without dropping the others, call get_flag first and pass the full list including the existing ones. Each rule is {"when": [{"attribute","operator","value"}, ...], "serve": <value>, "description"?: str}; conditions are AND-ed. Operators: ==, !=, >, <, >=, <=, in, contains. Pass [] to clear all rules.
